name: Workspace review with an approval checkpoint
description: Draft review criteria from supplied context, then approve the final checklist.

steps.name: Review criteria
steps.promptTemplate: From the supplied context, propose three concrete acceptance criteria. State any missing evidence. Do not claim to have inspected files or executed tests. Context: {{prompt}}

steps.name: Approved checklist
steps.promptTemplate: Turn these approved criteria into a concise manual review checklist with an expected result for each item: {{previous_output}}. Distinguish planned checks from completed evidence.
